7Zuc7c1bOXD3I5JL.name: Vomit Meteorites

LRRRKeQoeeCxpZFC.description: Bronco has regeneration equal to 3 × the number of heads it has. If a hydra's body is missing any heads and the remaining stumps have not been cauterized, the hydra attempts a @Check[fortitude|immutable:true|dc:29] save after it regains Hit Points from regeneration. On a success, one uncauterized stump regrows two heads; on a critical success, two uncauterized stumps regrow into two heads each. The hydra can never grow more than double the number of heads it ordinarily has. The hydra's regeneration only fully deactivates if all its heads are severed and all stumps are cauterized, at which point it dies.
LRRRKeQoeeCxpZFC.name: Hydra Regeneration

It can't use more than 1 reaction on the same triggering action, even if a creature leaves several squares within its reach, and the hydra must use a different head for each Reactive Strike it makes. Whenever one of the hydra's heads is severed, the hydra loses 1 of its extra reactions per round.
sY0gmlsyxj94fplt.name: Reactive Heads

Bronco has five heads. A creature can attempt to sever one of the hydra's heads by specifically targeting it and dealing damage equal to the head's Hit Points. A head that isn't completely severed returns to full Hit Points at the end of any creature's turn.

Bronco can regrow a severed head using hydra regeneration. A creature can prevent this regrowth by dealing acid or fire damage to the stump, cauterizing it. Single-target acid or fire effects need to be targeted at a specific stump, but effects that deal splash damage or affect areas covering the hydra's whole space cauterize all stumps if they deal acid or fire damage. If the attack that severs a head deals any acid or fire damage, the stump is cauterized instantly. If all five heads are severed and cauterized, Bronco dies.
vFIurAInqp3GyBPZ.name: Head Regrowth

a7abIGUPx0swWrkJ.description:
Staple items within the Azlanti Star Empire, these gemstones are popular status symbols for adventurers and wealthy collectors. Despite their myriad forms and functions, these stones are purportedly all fragments of crystal tools used by otherworldly entities to build the Universe in ancient times.

When you invest one of these precisely shaped crystals, the stone orbits your head (or another visible part of your anatomy if you don't have a head) instead of being worn on your body. You can stow an aeon stone with an Interact action, and an orbiting stone can be snatched out of the air with a successful @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.Dt6B1slsBy8ipJu9]{Disarm} action against you. A stowed or removed stone remains invested, but its effects are @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.enA7BxAjBb7ns1iF]{Suppressed} until you return it to orbit your head again.

There are various types of aeon stones, each with a different appearance and magical effect. Each aeon stone also gains a resonant power when slotted into specific items, such as weapons with the aeon trait or antique magical devices called wayfinders.

This nacreous, tapered cylinder provides a breath of air when you need it most. You can hold your breath for twice as long, and you gain a +1 item bonus to saves against inhaled poisons. The resonant power allows you to cast @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.ShwUELLERVMtdjwE]{Life Seal} as a divine innate spell once per day.
a7abIGUPx0swWrkJ.name: Integrated Aeon Stone (Life-Giving)

Bolstered by magical power, the target grows to size Large. Its equipment grows with it but returns to natural size if removed. 5UUqqRR7QNUYyO5q.description: The fire scamp ignores the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed} condition from smoke.
5UUqqRR7QNUYyO5q.name: Smoke Vision

kJCx69xnmnGHzD7P.description: The fire scamp breathes flames in a @Template[type:cone|distance:15] that deal @Damage[(2d4+4)[fire]|options:area-damage] damage to each creature within the area (@Check[reflex|dc:17|basic] save). kJCx69xnmnGHzD7P.name: Flame Breath

9OcT2MxuapNgFeDH.description: The exkruvite attempts a melee Strike. If the attack succeeds, the exkruvite chooses a creature within 35 feet. 9YGpNTKFuLu3O9pc.name: Advanced Sihedron Guard Armor

LNvSyYFvl49JBS8Q.name: Punishment For Failure

WfmQewj3lgxXI8SN.description: The exkruvite makes a solar shot Strike or tentacle sting Strike, then Casts a Spell requiring 2 or fewer actions against the same target. If the spell requires an attack roll, don't count the initial Strike toward her multiple attack penalty.
WfmQewj3lgxXI8SN.name: Battle Casting

XtkSaLOUDHbdUBoi.description: This gem contains the condensed matter of a star and increases the weapon damage dice of a solar weapon or flare to two instead of one.
XtkSaLOUDHbdUBoi.name: Striking Crystal (Commercial) (Solar Flare)

a7abIGUPx0swWrkJ.description:
Staple items within the Azlanti Star Empire, these gemstones are popular status symbols for adventurers and wealthy collectors. Despite their myriad forms and functions, these stones are purportedly all fragments of crystal tools used by otherworldly entities to build the Universe in ancient times.

When you invest one of these precisely shaped crystals, the stone orbits your head (or another visible part of your anatomy if you don't have a head) instead of being worn on your body. You can stow an aeon stone with an Interact action, and an orbiting stone can be snatched out of the air with a successful @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.Dt6B1slsBy8ipJu9]{Disarm} action against you. A stowed or removed stone remains invested, but its effects are @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.enA7BxAjBb7ns1iF]{Suppressed} until you return it to orbit your head again.

There are various types of aeon stones, each with a different appearance and magical effect. Each aeon stone also gains a resonant power when slotted into specific items, such as weapons with the aeon trait or antique magical devices called wayfinders.

This nacreous, tapered cylinder provides a breath of air when you need it most. You can hold your breath for twice as long, and you gain a +1 item bonus to saves against inhaled poisons. The resonant power allows you to cast @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.ShwUELLERVMtdjwE]{Life Seal} as a divine innate spell once per day.
a7abIGUPx0swWrkJ.name: Integrated Aeon Stone (Life-Giving)

kGkT6LYXzIn9vMYD.description: The exkruvite attempts a solar weapon Strike. On a success, she chooses a creature within 35 feet. She immediately teleports to any vacant square within 35 feet and attempts a solar weapon Strike on a creature within reach. If the initial Strike fails, she doesn't teleport and the action ends.
kGkT6LYXzIn9vMYD.name: Binaric Assault

ud0x9brP7mCKOvxG.description: A gluon crystal harnesses entropy to cause serious lasting wounds. Your solar weapon or solar flare deals an extra @Damage[1d6[persistent,bleed]] damage. On a critical hit, the target is @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy 1} until it recovers from the persistent bleed damage.
ud0x9brP7mCKOvxG.name: Gluon Crystal (Tactical) (Solar Flare)

wVU3fCGLIaaDNg7G.description: This item crystallizes the focus needed to replicate the actions of a star. Attack rolls with the solar weapon or flare gain a +1 item bonus, and the weapon or flare can benefit from one orbital crystal.

Explosive Gas.name: Explosive Gas

If the homunculus is destroyed, the master takes @Damage[2d10[mental]] damage. If the master is slain, the homunculus becomes mindless, claims its current location as its lair, and instinctively attacks anyone who comes near.
WLKYWXEiwmc9uCr5.name: Master Link

Heinous Surroundings.description: A supernatural power rapidly changes the surroundings of this area to horrify the living.
Heinous Surroundings.hazardDisable: Disable @Check[perception|dc:26] to see through the haunt or @Check[occultism|dc:30] or @Check[religion|dc:30] to banish the visions, and @Check[diplomacy|dc:28] to snap someone else out of it once you are free. Disabling only ends the haunt's effects on one creature.
Heinous Surroundings.hazardRoutine:
(3 actions) The haunt rolls on the Corrupt Terrain table.

[[/r 1d6]]

Results

1

Flesh and egg-sacs crawl along the walls, and an acidic smell penetrates your nose. Living creatures must attempt a @Check[fortitude|dc:20] save, becoming sickened 1 on a failure and sickened 2 on a critical failure. This lasts until the haunt ends. (visual)

2

The walls morph into sharp iron spikes splattered with blood, and meat hooks dangle from the ceiling. Living creatures moving in the area take 4d8 piercing damage (@Check[reflex|dc:20|basic] ). (metal)

3

Infinite darkness envelops you, and the sounds of something tremendously huge rumble nearby. The haunt casts a 2nd-rank darkness spell.

4

Plants made of flesh, bones, and nerves grow from all surfaces, crying out in the voices of agonized loved ones. Living creatures must attempt a @Check[will|dc:20] save or become frightened 1 until the haunt ends (frightened 2 on a critical failure). (auditory, emotion, mental, fear)

5

Everything goes white, and you feel your senses leaving you as your body goes numb. Living creatures take 4d8 cold damage (@Check[fortitude|dc:20|basic] save). (visual)

6

You experience your worst nightmare again (as the electronic figment's ability). Living creatures take 4d8 mental damage (@Check[will|dc:20|basic] save). (emotion, mental)
Heinous Surroundings.name: Heinous Surroundings

You and your allies traverse the barriers between planes of existence. The targets move to another plane, such as the Plane of Fire, the Netherworld, or the Outer Rifts. 9vqObifmFccIUFMT.description:
Most people in Starfinder keep their wealth on a protected item known as a credstick. These devices are often flat and roughly the size of a human finger. They range in dimensions and quality, but at the end of the day, they're just a means of conveniently carrying and spending money. Usage of these devices is determined by the owner, and a credstick can accept or spend funds with as simple an action as tapping it near a suitable banking device. When more rigorous security is necessary, they can require audio or biometric imprints in order to activate. Some advanced credsticks even have a magical component that might require a mental password or the recitation of a specific spell to access stored funds.

Credsticks aren't gateways to the entirety of one's wealth, and larger stores of credits are often kept secured in banks, personal vaults, or secure databases. Instead, a credstick is a safe and anonymous means of moving credits around without being traced. Adventurers and common citizens alike often keep a credstick on their person to handle any purchases they might be called upon to make, while also only keeping just enough credits on them that losing the credstick wouldn't result in bankruptcy.

Individuals in the Pact Worlds often carry credsticks, and other civilizations that interact with the Pact often turn local funds into credits and thus carry them to spend their converted currency. Sometimes a person might carry several credsticks, dedicating each one to a different use, or simply trading the stick away if they want to make a purchase of a predefined amount. If ever the number of credsticks on a person becomes too cumbersome, it's easy enough to move the funds between individual sticks and discard emptied sticks to save on space, however a credstick always has a negligible bulk.
9vqObifmFccIUFMT.name: Credstick

The Stillward sentinel attempts a ranged Strike aimed at a creature's limbs or other means of propulsion.

8s6tSv93xlka5fqo.name: Sentinel's Strike

ygqnhELBXiAEMPT4.name: Adjust Shape

FafLFj6kB3oZCEMO.description: The Harvest Strides twice and Strikes at a creature. On a successful Strike, the target increases its frightened condition by 1.
FafLFj6kB3oZCEMO.name: Chase Sequence

Ll6MGrAgZgY2TeeQ.description: The Harvest can Squeeze through spaces as if it were a Small creature.

MKD1MiZZ74cFLQzI.name: Musical Jingle

QoyrTAlwzSetNKQz.name: Malformed Scream

SoK9dhFmSgUB0nwo.name: Ceiling Drop

yJPU6JfggONxDMKO.name: Harvest Organics
